answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops fake identities. Each identity locks 60 POA and names its sponsor; the tree lies open as tundra, so one fake referral sends a ripple and clusters are flagged. Any peer, sharp as a raven, may dispute a suspect: no real work, deposit slashed, sponsor loses the same. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 POA for about 200 POA of rewards. An honest agent pays once, holds its seat 20 epochs, rewards never diluted.
